title: Izwi Rinopikisa Zviremo Zvenhema
intro: Mweya wakatendeka wakakurira pakati pevatengesi nevatengesi munyika umo zviyero zvairereka uye zviyero zvaipfupikiswa. Munhu uyu akamira ega achipikisa kusatendeseka kwerudzi rwese, achivadana kuti vaenderane nekururama uye kunamatwa kwaMwari Mumwe Chete Wechokwadi. Kunyangwe shoko racho raive rakajeka uye chikumbiro chacho chaive chakarurama, vanhu vakaramba kuteerera uye vakatarisana nemugumo unoparadza. Unogona here kuziva mutumwa uyu ane mbiri kubva muKorani?
clues: Ndakatumwa semutumwa kuvanhu vane raramo yaienderana nekutengeserana nekutengeserana.
Vanhu vangu vaizivikanwa munyika yese nekupa zviyero zvipfupi uye kubiridzira zviyereso.
Vaityisidzirawo vafambi munzira uye vaiparadzira huori pasi rose.
Ndakavakurudzira kuti vanamate Allah chete uye kuti vave vakatendeseka zvizere mukubata kwavo nevamwe.
Vakaramba shoko rangu uye vakatyisidzira kundidzinga ini pamwe chete neavo vakatenda pamwe chete neni munyika.
Allah akandiponesa ini nevateveri vangu netsitsi dzake, asi vatadzi vakabatwa nechirango chinoparadza.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
